description: This file defines an interface named Validator that provides methods for validation status and reason for failure.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: An interface representing a general-purpose validator with methods to check validity and retrieve failure reasons.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the validation was successful, returning true if valid, false otherwise.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Provides an Optional containing the reason for validation failure, if any.
